answer: Stop sybils with one island per identity, one knoll, and one vine. Each identity is marooned on a lone island: a bond shard in isolated escrow, never lent, so one stake backs one face. Influence grows only by vine, a chain of endorsements from unrelated peers, each link staked by its signer. Each epoch one knoll rises: one audit seat pulls a random vine to trace its root. Vine chains on one root are cut together; every island bond behind them burns, multiplied by the count. One honest agent risks one island; N clones stake N island bonds for one root and forfeit roughly N squared.
